Run in this pod with a stand-in agent, bun answers `error: Package "9.6.1" with tag "latest" not found, but package exists` / `error: 9.6.1@ failed to resolve` (and the same for 9.5.1), the wrapper prints `legion plugins: installing 9.6.1 and 9.5.1 failed` and exits 1 before `exec` — no `AGENT STARTED`. Tarball paths and http(s) URLs (what the implementer's proof and stage 4a's checkpoint use) work, so neither caught it. Consequence under production's default source, the release-linked pair: at the first boot every live claim is relaunched, every install fails before Oh My Pi starts, the launcher reports the child gone, each death is charged, and the launch budget ends every live role in `worker-died` — the fleet-wide stall this change exists to prevent.
